**Machine Learning Engineer**
**New York, NY** 
 \|
 **Full Time**
 COMPENSATION RANGE: 140,000\.00 \- 170,000\.00 (On Target Earnings)
   

  

**The Role:**
 As a Machine Learning Senior Engineer you will be part of all the major architectural decisions and developments we make on our algorithms, especially in our deep neural network algorithms
   

  

**What you will do:**
* You will be responsible for developing new features, measuring the performance and improving our pipelines. Our ML Engineer role combines the classic "ML Scientist" and "Data Engineer" role at other companies
* You will also play an analytical role researching, designing, implementing, and deploying full\-stack scalable data analytics and machine learning solutions to challenge business issues, as well as working closely with our Tech and Ops team
* You will work on unique modeling challenges not covered in the scientific literature, like extreme positive sample sparsity and labelling delay.
* Analyze data from different sources and provide actionable insights to business and engineering stakeholders


**What’s in it for you?**
* Great compensation package tailored to the U.S. market.
* Career pathing and continued education available
* Highly engaged leadership to support you in your position and career
* Opportunity for international travel
* Comprehensive medical, dental \& vision benefits
* 401k matching
* Summer Fridays \& Team building events


**Skills and requirements:**
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in Data science positions
* Very strong coding ability: Python, Scala, Java
* Proficiency in building high\-performance algorithms in production
* Proficiency in solving problems
* Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical significance tests)
* Experience in data mining and predictive modelling: deep neural networks, logistic regression, clustering and time series analysis models
* Knowledge of Bitbucket/Git version tools
* Experience working with SQL and data warehousing
* Possesses excellent communication skills both verbal and written
* Able to mentor other team members
* Fluency in English
